meta.title: Monthly management pack
meta.description: Ostrand & Pell's monthly management pack on A4, for a month and a region you pick. Four KPI tiles that turn red when a target is missed, revenue against budget, utilisation and pipeline charts, fees by region and service line in a matrix, the pipeline and active projects, and each region's commentary. In the HTML viewer, regions open to their projects and projects to their notes.

params.name: month
params.label: Month
params.description: The month the pack reports on.

params.name: region
params.label: Region
params.description: One region, or all of them.

main.description: Twelve months of fees, budgets and hours by region, with today's active projects, pipeline and each region's commentary.

vars.fyRevenue: Sum(vars.fees.filter(f, f.month >= vars.fyStart && f.month <= params.month).map(f, f.amount))
vars.fyBudget: Sum(vars.regionMonths.filter(r, r.month >= vars.fyStart && r.month <= params.month).map(r, r.budget))
vars.window: Distinct(data.main.regionMonths.map(r, r.month)).filter(m, m <= params.month && m > DateAdd(params.month, -12, 'month'))
vars.trend: vars.window.map(m, {'month': m, 'revenue': Sum(vars.fees.filter(f, f.month == m).map(f, f.amount)), 'budget': Sum(vars.regionMonths.filter(r, r.month == m).map(r, r.budget)), 'utilisation': Sum(vars.regionMonths.filter(r, r.month == m).map(r, r.billableHours)) / Sum(vars.regionMonths.filter(r, r.month == m).map(r, r.availableHours))})
vars.stages: ['Qualifying', 'Proposal', 'Shortlisted', 'Verbal win'].map(s, {'stage': s, 'value': Sum(vars.pipeline.filter(p, p.stage == s).map(p, p.value)), 'weighted': Sum(vars.pipeline.filter(p, p.stage == s).map(p, p.value * p.probability))})
